title_en: Decision of the Supreme People's Court on Revising the Provisions on Several Issues concerning the Application of the Company Law of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en: 1. The 'Article 75' in Article 3 of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of the Company Law of the People's Republic of China (I) (Fa Shi [2006] No. 3, hereinafter referred to as the 'Provisions (I)') is amended to 'Article 74'.
2. The 'Article 152' in Article 4 of the Provisions (I) is amended to 'Article 151'.

3. The 'Article 183' in the first paragraph of Article 1 of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of the Company Law of the People's Republic of China (II) (Fa Shi [2008] No. 6, hereinafter referred to as the 'Provisions (II)') is amended to 'Article 182'.
4. The 'Article 184' in Article 2 and the first paragraph of Article 7 of the Provisions (II) is amended to 'Article 183'.
5. The 'Article 186' in Article 11 of the Provisions (II) is amended to 'Article 185'.
6. The 'Article 81' in the first paragraph of Article 22 of the Provisions (II) is amended to 'Article 80'.
7. The 'Article 152' in the second and third paragraphs of Article 23 of the Provisions (II) is amended to 'Article 151'.

8. Item (1) of Article 12 of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of the Company Law of the People's Republic of China (III) (Fa Shi [2011] No. 3, hereinafter referred to as the 'Provisions (III)') is deleted, and that Article is amended to: 'After the establishment of a company, where the company, shareholders or company creditors request the people's court to determine that a relevant shareholder has withdrawn its capital contribution on the ground that the shareholder's conduct falls under any of the following circumstances and damages the company's rights and interests, the people's court shall support the request: (1) making false financial accounting statements to inflate profits for distribution; (2) transferring out its capital contribution by fabricating creditor-debt relationships; (3) transferring out the capital contribution through affiliated transactions; (4) other acts of withdrawing capital contributions without statutory procedures.'
9. The 'Article 148' in the fourth paragraph of Article 13 of the Provisions (III) is amended to 'Article 147'.
10. Article 15 of the Provisions (III) is deleted.
11. Article 24 of the Provisions (III) is changed to Article 23. The 'Articles 32 and 33' in that Article are amended to 'Articles 31 and 32'.
12. The sequence of the articles of the Provisions (III) is adjusted accordingly.

13. After this Decision takes effect, this Decision shall apply to cases involving disputes over shareholders' capital contributions that have not yet been finally adjudicated; if a case has been finally adjudicated before this Decision takes effect, this Decision shall not apply where the parties apply for a retrial or a retrial is decided in accordance with the trial supervision procedure.
The Provisions (I), the Provisions (II) and the Provisions (III) shall be amended accordingly in accordance with this Decision and be re-promulgated.
